title: Within-species flower-colour variation shows achromatic–chromatic alignment beyond coarse colour-state composition
description: Data, code, frozen protocols, results, figures and provenance archive supporting the New Phytologist manuscript on cross-species structure of within-species flower-colour variation. The archive is self-contained for replay of the frozen statistical analyses from checksum-verified measured tables, includes the exact historical analysis code and image-measurement model bytes, and preserves source-photo identities/hashes. Original third-party iNaturalist image pixels were intentionally not persisted, so future pixel-level reacquisition depends on provider availability.
notes: Do not publish until creator order, ORCIDs, affiliations, licence and final author approvals are confirmed. The archive does not claim permanent self-contained reconstruction of original iNaturalist image bytes. Third-party/derived model files carry separate attribution/licence notices and must not be silently relicensed under a blanket archive licence.
